name: Voxel-based Object Simplification via Multi-layered Marching Cubes
definition: A method to simplify 3D objects by convolving high-resolution volume buffers with low-pass filters of varying support radii, reconstructing surfaces via Marching Cubes at multiple isodensity levels to create a hierarchy of meshes that reduces genus and high-frequency features.
summary: Voxel-based Object Simplification via Multi-layered Marching Cubes simplifies 3D objects by convolving volume buffers with low-pass filters and reconstructing surfaces at multiple isodensity levels to create a mesh hierarchy that reduces genus and provides object-space antialiasing.
